summary: Sprint 5 (premium AI-guided experience) verified end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (15 phase3 regression + 8 new sprint tests covering /ai/diagnose causes, /missions top_matches ranking + enriched cards, /missions/{id}/book happy path, unknown artisan -> 404, ownership -> 404, regression smoke for /auth/login, /artisans?category=plombier, /bookings/mine, GET /missions/{id} live tracking + arrived flip, /complete). Frontend AI flow: login client.test@proconnect.fr -> Home 'J'ai un problème' (problem-button) -> /diagnose -> typed problem -> 'Analyser avec l'IA' shows full-screen 'Analyse IA en cours' overlay (testID ai-analyzing) with rotating messages + progress, lasts ~5s before the report. Report shows 'Causes possibles' section (verified). 'Trouver le meilleur pro' navigates to matching screen titled 'Meilleurs profils sélectionnés par notre IA' with multiple pro cards each displaying all 3 trust-badge testIDs (badge-identity / badge-insurance / badge-verified) and a 'book-{artisan_id}' button. Tapping book-* navigates to tracking screen showing the full stepper Demandé/Accepté/En route/Arrivé/Terminé, an ETA in minutes (e.g. '40 min'), the artisan card (name + rating + trade), and a 'Marquer comme terminé' complete button (web fallback for the map rendered correctly as styled placeholder). Empty states: fresh client -> /bookings shows EmptyState with empty-diagnose-cta which navigates to /diagnose; /messages shows empty-conv-cta. Artisan detail (/artisan/art_5f2800465026 — Lucas Moreau): all 3 trust badges (Identité vérifiée / Assurance vérifiée / Pro vérifié) rendered below the 'Profil vérifié' row, plus Top noté / Réponse rapide / Partenaire Premium tags. ZERO pageerror, ZERO red-screen. No new RN-Web warnings beyond known carry-over (shadow*, pointerEvents).

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web deprecation warnings persist (shadow* style props and pointerEvents prop on LinearGradient). Non-blocking, cosmetic. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:30 and shadow usage across /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic carry-over) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and pass pointerEvents via style on LinearGradient in onboarding.tsx to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:584-637 /ai/diagnose prompt now requests `causes` (2-3) and pydantic-free JSON parsing has a fallback that omits `causes` — fallback path returns dict WITHOUT 'causes' key. Frontend already guards with `diag.causes?.length > 0` so it is safe, but consider adding a default `causes: []` in the fallback dict for schema stability.

server.py:710-750 /missions correctly computes top_matches via mission_artisan_card + match_eta and ranks via match_score (rating*8 + trust*0.4 + accept*0.2 - resp*0.1 - distance*0.25). artisan == top_matches[0] verified.

server.py:752-774 /missions/{id}/book correctly returns 404 for unknown artisan AND 404 for missions not owned by the caller (same status — acceptable but consider 403 for ownership). distance/eta computed with proper haversine fallback when artisan has no lat/lng.
diagnose.tsx properly Promise.all's the LLM call with a 5200ms timer to enforce the premium overlay minimum, and the overlay (`<AIAnalyzing/>`) is only mounted while `analyzing===true`.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral client account empty_state_<unix_ts>@proconnect.fr / test1234 to exercise empty-state CTAs. Reused client.test@proconnect.fr for the AI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All sprint-5 testIDs verified live: ai-analyzing, find-pro-button, analyze-button, problem-text, problem-button, book-{artisan_id}, badge-identity, badge-insurance, badge-verified, empty-diagnose-cta, empty-conv-cta. Tracking screen shows step labels Demandé/Accepté/En route/Arrivé/Terminé as plain Txt — assert via document.body.innerText, not testIDs. Matching title text: 'Meilleurs profils sélectionnés par notre IA'. /api/ai/diagnose is REAL GPT-4o (expensive) — keep to one call per session; backend sprint test file does ONE LLM call for causes verification. Web preview returns a styled map fallback ('Carte temps réel disponible sur l'app mobile') instead of react-native-maps — expected.
